content: Apimelek
Apimelek nein Kidion ahpw kohla Sekem, wasa rien eh nohno kan koaros kin koukousoan ie. Ih eri ndaiong irail

re en idek rehn tohn Sekem kan, “Dahme kumwail lemeleme me pahn mwahu ong kumwail, ma pwutak 70 koaros nein Kidion en kaunkumwailda, de aramastehmen en kaun kumwail? Kumwail tamataman me ngehi iei kisehmwail oh pil ntahmwail.”
Rien eh nohno ko eri tuhkihong tohn Sekem kan duwen irair wet. Irail koaros eri pwungkipene re en idawehn Apimelek pwehki eh kisehrail.
Irail pil kihong mwohni silper 70 sang ni mwohni en tehnpas en Paal-en-Inou. Apimelek eri ale mwohni pwukat oh kisekisehkihla aramas soh katepe kei pwe re en pil iangala ih.
Mwuhr, e ahpw kohla ni imwen eh pahpao nan Opra, oh kemehla nein Kidion pwutak 70 ko pohn takai ehu. Ahpw Sodam, nein Kidion pwutak keieu tikitiko, pitsang mehla, pwehki eh rukula.
Ohl en Sekem oh ohl en Pedmilo koaros, ahpw pokonpene oh kohla nin tuhke sarawien Sekem, wasa re kasapwilada Apimelek ie pwehn wiahla ar nanmwarki.
Ni Sodam eh rongada duwen met, e ahpw kohla oh uh pohn Nahna Kerisim, oh werlahng irail nda, “Kumwail tohn Sekem koaros, kumwail rong ie, pwe Koht en ketin karongei kumwail!
Dene ahnsou ehu tuhke kan pokonpene pwe re en pilada pein arail nanmwarki. Re ahpw ndaiong tuhke olip, ‘Komwi me pahn ketin wia at nanmwarki.’
A tuhke olipo sapeng irail, nda, ‘Ia duwe, I pahn kesehkihla ei leh me kin doadoahk ni kawahupen koht akan, pwe I en kaunkumwailda?’
Tuhke ko eri ndalahng tuhke piko, ‘Komwi me pahn ketin wia at nanmwarki.’
A tuhke piko sapeng irail, nda, ‘Ia duwe, I pahn kesehkihla ei wahntuhke iou oh kaselel, pwe I en kaunkumwailda?’
Tuhke ko eri ndalahng tuhkehn waino, ‘Komwi me pahn ketin wia at nanmwarki.’
A tuhkehn waino sapeng irail, nda, ‘Ia duwe, I pahn kesehkihla ei wain, me kin kaparanda koht akan oh aramas akan, pwe I en kaunkumwailda?’
Tuhke ko eri ndalahng kisin tuhke tekateko, ‘Komwi me pahn ketin wia at nanmwarki.’

Tuhke tekateko ahpw sapeng irail, nda, ‘Ma kumwail uhdahn mwahuki I en wia amwail nanmwarki, a kumwail kohdo oh rirla pahn mwetehi. Pwe ma soh, kisiniei pahn kohdahsang nin tuhke tekatek oh kamwasikahla tuhke sidar kan en Lepanon.’

Sodam pil nda, “Eri met, kumwail nan kapehd mwakelekel oh mehlel ni kesepwildahn Apimelek en nanmwarki? Kumwail wauneki Kidion oh eh peneinei duwen me konehng, oh kin kapingkalahngankihong mehkoaros me e wiahiong kumwail?
Kumwail tamanda duwen ei pahpao eh mahwenkin kumwail, pwe en kapitasang kumwail pahn manaman en mehn Midian.
Pwe rahnwet kumwail uhwongehr en ei pahpao eh peneinei. Kumwail kemelahr nah pwutak ko—oh kasapwiladahr Apimelek, me nein lih lidu men, pwe en wiahla nanmwarkien Sekem, pwehki eh kisehmwail.
Eri, ma kumwail nan kapehd mwakelekel oh mehlel ni amwail wiahda mepwukat ong Kidion oh eh peneinei, a kumwail en perenkihda amwail nanmwarki Apimelek, oh ih en ketin iang kumwail pereperen.
A ma soh, kisiniei en kohsang rehn Apimelek oh isikala tohn Sekem oh Pedmilo iangahki Apimelek.”
Sodam eri tangdoaui. E ahpw tangala oh kousoanla Peer, pwehki eh masak rie Apimelek.
Apimelek eri kaunda Israel erein sounpar siluh.
Koht eri ketin mweidohng nanpwung suwed en miehla nanpwungen Apimelek oh aramas en Sekem, aramas ako eri pelianda oh uhwong Apimelek.
Met wiawiher pwe Apimelek oh mehn Sekem ko me painohng en kemehla nein Kidion pwutak isiakano, en lokolongki ar sapwung laudo.
Mehn Sekem ahpw kin rukuruk oh mwasamwasahn Apimelek pohn nahna kan, irail ahpw kin kulih aramas koaros me kin keid wasao; pakair ahpw wiawihong Apimelek.
Kaal nein Eped eri kohdo Sekem iangahki rie ko; aramas en Sekem eri koapworopworkihla.

Irail koaros eri kohieila nan ar mwetin wain akan oh dolung wahn wain oh wiahkihda wain, re ahpw wiahda lapalahn kamadipw ehu. Irail eri kohla nan tehnpas en ar koht, wasa re tungoal oh niminim ie oh kepikepitki Apimelek.

Kaal eri nda, “Soangen aramas da kei kitail nan Sekem? Dahme kitail wie papahki Apimelek? Ihs ih? Nein Kidion pwutak! Oh Sepul kin kapwaiada dahme Apimelek kin koasoanehdi, eri, ia kahrepen atail pahn papah? Kumwail loalopwoatohng samamwailo, Amor, me tepin kauwada amwail peneinei!
I ahpw men ngehi me kakaun aramas pwukat! Pwe I pahn kapweiekdi Apimelek! I pahn ndaiong, ‘Kakehlahda sapwellimomwi karis kan oh ketido, kita pahn mahwen!’”
Sepul, kaunen kahnimwo, ahpw engiengda ni eh karongehda pato pwukat.
Ih eri kadarala meninkeder kei rehn Apimelek nan Aruma, me ketihtihki, “Kaal nein Eped oh rie kan leledohngehr Sekem oh re sohte pahn mweidohng komwi en ketilong nan kahnimwet.
Eri, komwi oh sapwellimomwi sounpei kan kumwail ketieila nipwong oh rukula nansapw.
Ninsohrahn en lakapw kumwail en mahweniong kahnimwet, oh ni ahnsou me Kaal oh ienge kan pahn peliankumwailda, kumwail uhwong oh mahweniong irail uwen amwail kak.”
Eri, Apimelek oh nah sounpei koaros ahpw mwekidieila nipwongo oh rukula likin Sekem ni pwihn pahieu.
Ahnsou me Apimelek oh ienge ko koaros kilangada Kaal eh kohkohiei oh uh ni wenihmwen kahnimwo, re uhdahsang nan arail wasahn rukula kan.
Kaal kilangirailda oh ndalahng Sepul, “Kilang mahs kiden aramas eh kohkohdihsang pohn nahna kan!” Sepul ahpw sapeng, “Kaidehn aramas ekei mwo, pwe mwete kei me mi pohn nahnao!”
Kaal ahpw pwurehng nda, “Kadehde mwahu! Aramas ekei kohkohdihsang pohn kumwen nahnao oh pil ehu pwihn kohkohdo nan ahl me kohsang ni tuhke ohk en aramas en kosetipw kan.”
Sepul eri ndaiong, “Eri, ia omw lokaia laud oh aklapalap met, kowe me nda, “Ihs Apimelek pwe kitail en papah? Ih aramas pwukat me ke mwamwahliki. Eri, met kohla oh mahweniong irail.”
Kaal ahpw kahluwalahng mehn Sekem ko pwe re en mahweniong Apimelek.
Apimelek eri pwakih Kaal, Kaal eri tangdoaui. Me tohto rehrail me ohla oh wonohnpene lellahng ni wenihmwen kehlo.
Apimelek eri kousoanla Aruma, a Sepul ahpw pwakihasang Kaal oh rie ko Sekem, irail eri sohla kak kousoan wasao.
Mandahsang rahno Apimelek diarada me mehn Sekem koasoakoasoane re en kohieilahng nansapw.
Ih eri ale nah sounpei ko oh wiahkihda pwihn siluh, irail eri rukula nansapw. Ni eh kilangada aramas ako ar kohkohieisang nan kahnimwo, e ahpw pwaradahsang wasa me e rukuruk ie oh kemeirailla.
Ni Apimelek oh nah pwihno ar mwadangalahng silehdi ewen kehlo, a pwihn riau teiko ahpw mahweniong aramas akan nansapwo oh kemeirailla koaros.
Re mahmahwenpene rahno pwon. Apimelek eri kalowehdi kahnimwo, kemehla towe kan, kamwomwala oh kamwarakdiong soahl pohn pwehlo.
Ni ahnsou me mehn Sekem ko me mihmi nan kehlo rongada met, re ahpw tangala rukula nan kelen mahwen en tehnpas en Paal-en-Inou.
Pakair eri kohieng Apimelek me re pokopokon wasao,
ih eri kohdahla pohn Nahna Salmon iangahki nah sounpei ko. E ahpw ale sile pwoat oh pelehdi rahn tuhke pwoat, ih eri kapaikada. E ahpw ndahng nah sounpei ko re en mwadang pil wiahda soahngohte.

Emenemen irail koaros ahpw pelehdi rahn tuhke, oh idawehnla Apimelek oh koasoakedahng lepin tuhke ko ni kelen mahweno. Re ahpw isikala iangahki aramas ako me mihmi loale, irail koaros eri mehla, ohl oh lih kid.
Apimelek ahpw kohla Depes, kapilpene kahnimwo oh kalowehdi.
Mie imwen doulik ehu wasao, oh tohn kahnimwo koaros tangala loale iangahki kaun akan. Re ahpw loakehdi ihmwo oh doudahla powe.
Ni ahnsou me Apimelek mahweniong imwen douliko, e kohla ni wenihmwo pwehn isikala ihmwo.
Lih emen ahpw kesehdiong takai en wiahda pilawa amas pohn moangeo oh kamwutepene.

E ahpw mwadangete ekerodo mwahnakapw me kin weuwa nah dipwisoun mahwen ko oh ndahng, “Ale noumw kedlahsen oh kemeiehla. I sohte men aramas en nda me lih emen me kemeiehla.” Mwahnakapwo eri ale nah kedlahso oh kemehla.
Ahnsou me mehn Israel ko kilangada duwen Apimelek eh melahr, irail koaros ahpw kohkohla ni imwarail ko.
Iei duwen KAUN-O eh ketin kapwung ong Apimelek sapwung me e wiahiong eh pahpa ni eh kemehla rie pwutak isiakano.
Koht pil ketin kalokehki mehn Sekem ko arail suwed, nin duwen me Sodam nein Kidion patohwanehr ni eh kerieirailla.
